_comment: VB-15 / D15. Real questions this estate asks whose answers plausibly need a hop over the entity layer (30-Entities typed edges) or wikilinks. 'expected' are note stems (entity or document) that MUST all appear in an arm's hit list for that arm to score success on the query. Expected sets were derived by hand from the typed edges actually present in the vault on 2026-08-30 (grep of 30-Entities frontmatter), so the checks are deterministic and vault-grounded, not invented.
